$comment: Section order transcribed from src/pages/*.jsx and src/pages/routes.jsx; route list from https://rileyapp.com/sitemap.xml (244 URLs, fetched 2026-10-13) plus /pricing (live, not in sitemap). Home/pricing/404 measured in CLONE_SPEC.md and CLONE_SPEC_PAGES_MARKETING.md; blog, article, text and legal templates measured in CLONE_SPEC_PAGES_BLOG.md (§0.3 chrome-per-route table, §1 reuse matrix). /blog?page=N (37 pages) are query-string views of the blog index, not separate routes.

meta.title: Riley (rileyapp.com) clone — information architecture
meta.status: measured — all templates specced and built; 3 author pages pending

pendingRoutes.reason: Author pages are out of scope: not specced or built. In the clone they fall through to the 404 via BlogArticlePage.

meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill (hand-edited ia.json; IA.md and matrix.csv generated by build.mjs)

categories.CHROME: Site-wide frame: announcement bar, header, footer and cookie banner.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block directly under the header.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: press logos, expert board, user testimonials.
categories.PRODUCT: Explains what Riley does and how it works.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to move the visitor to sign up or compare plans.
categories.BLOG: Blog listing UI: discovery, filtering and paging of posts.
categories.ARTICLE: Blocks of the single-article reading template.

chrome.announcement-bar.description: Lilac strip above the header with a one-line announcement and link; hidden below 992px.
chrome.announcement-bar.scope: 15 routes: homepage, pricing, every dead landing slug, the blog index, editorial process and each legal page; absent on category and article pages.

chrome.site-header.description: Logo, primary nav links, 'What's New?' and the app CTA; becomes fixed with blur after 54px of scroll; hamburger with slide-up menu below 992px.

hero.home-parallax.description: Homepage hero: 'Meet Riley' serif H1, sub-copy, primary CTA and hero illustration over four looping, scroll-parallaxed cloud layers.

proof.press-marquee.description: Lilac strip of press logos scrolling left in a 20s linear loop with edge fade mask; sits at the bottom of the homepage hero.

proof.family-marquee.description: Personalisation heading over a row of parenting-style 'family' illustrations scrolling right in a 50s linear loop.

product.superpowers-grid.description: Two-column grid of six parenting-challenge cards; each opens a full-screen modal with mascot, three feature cards and a CTA.

product.chat-featurette.description: Orange looping carousel of phone mockups playing Rive chat animations, with prev/next arrows and a 'Talk to Riley' CTA.

proof.clinical-board.description: Expert/clinical advisory board: doctor portraits with names and credentials.

product.how-it-works.description: 'How Riley Works' explainer on the latte-100 background with large serif heading and step content.

proof.testimonial-carousel.description: Looping five-slide carousel of user quotes with avatar, stars and prev/next arrows.

product.feature-cards.description: Three coloured feature cards (apricot, lilac, marigold) at the top of the pink-orange gradient band.
product.feature-cards.scope: Homepage only (1 route); the pricing page renders the gradient band without it.

conversion.comparison-table.description: Riley-vs-alternatives feature matrix with filled/empty checks; header labels rotate at 960px and below.
conversion.comparison-table.scope: Homepage and pricing (2 routes), inside the gradient band.

support.faq-clouds.description: Large FAQ heading with question 'clouds'; opening one centres it and blurs the rest; background clouds slide aside 1s after the section enters view.

content.blog-teaser.description: 'Explore the Riley Blog' block: category pills and three post cards; a horizontal snap scroller at 639px and below.

conversion.final-cta.description: Closing sign-up band with large serif heading, clouds, mascots and the primary CTA.
conversion.final-cta.scope: 230 routes: homepage, pricing, the blog index, every category page and every article, directly above the footer.

chrome.site-footer.description: Footer with logo, link columns, newsletter sign-up, app-store badge and copyright line.

hero.pricing-plans.description: Pricing hero: tangerine radial background with the reused cloud layers at 70% opacity, eyebrow, H1, two plan cards (Riley Plus+, Riley Basic) and a large CTA with arrow.

error.not-found.description: 'Playing peekaboo' 404 body: serif heading, one-line message, 'Go back' link and wide cloud illustration; sets robots noindex.
error.not-found.scope: The 8 dead sitemap slugs, plus any unknown path via the router fallback.

chrome.cookie-consent.description: Fixed bottom-right translucent cookie notice ('Learn more' → /privacy) with an OK button; hides for a year once accepted.
chrome.cookie-consent.scope: Every one of the 242 mapped routes (mounted once, globally).

blog.index-hero.description: Mascot, 'Riley Articles' serif heading, subtitle and books illustration opening the blog listing.
blog.index-hero.scope: Blog index and every category page (7 routes).

blog.search.description: Live type-ahead search box with a results dropdown; the clone filters blogPosts.json locally instead of calling the original's search API.
blog.search.scope: Blog index and every category page (7 routes); articles embed the same component inside article.top-bar.

blog.category-tabs.description: Row of category tabs (All plus six categories and Authors) with the active one highlighted; distinct from the homepage blog-teaser pills.
blog.category-tabs.scope: Blog index and every category page (7 routes).

blog.featured-banner.description: Large featured-post banner: horizontal at 992px and up, stacked below.
blog.featured-banner.scope: Blog index and every category page (7 routes); empty on health and pregnancy, which have no featured posts.

blog.post-grid.description: Grid of post cards (wide and normal variants) with category tag, title, excerpt, author and date; 6 posts per page on the index.
blog.post-grid.scope: Blog index and every category page (7 routes).

blog.pagination.description: 'Page N of M' control with prev/next links to /blog?page=N.
blog.pagination.scope: Blog index and every category page (7 routes); category pages always show a single page.

article.top-bar.description: Back link plus search box at 992px and up; full-width search only below.

article.breadcrumbs.description: Pill breadcrumb trail Home › Blog › Category › Title.

article.header.description: Title, description, author and reviewer bylines, updated date and read time, top share buttons and the hero image.

article.toc.description: 'In this article' table of contents: sticky side column at 992px and up, inline box below, with its own copy-link button.

article.body.description: Rich-text article body: paragraphs, h2/h3, nested lists, citation superscripts, promo unit, editor's note and images. Body copy is placeholder in the clone.

article.share-row.description: Bottom row of share buttons and copy-link after the sources.

article.related-posts.description: 'You'll also love these posts:' heading with a carousel area and See All button; renders empty on the original, so empty in the clone too.

legal.editorial-prose.description: Editorial-process prose body: headings and lists running edge to edge with no side padding (an original quirk); placeholder copy in the clone.

legal.policy-embed.description: Empty policy embed slot: the original's third-party policy embed is blocked by its own security policy, so the body renders 0px tall.
